newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: CZECH PX50 CONTINUES TO FALL AT FIXING.
newsitem.headline: CZECH PX50 CONTINUES TO FALL AT FIXING.

text.p: Czech shares slid further at Wednesday's price fixing despite small gains from SPT Telecom and CEZ which fell sharply in the previous session.
SPT rose 18 crowns to 3,072 while power utility CEZ rose one crown to 905.
The most heavily weighted share on the PX50, Komercni Banka fell 30 crowns to 1,970. Savings bank Ceska Sporitelna also dropped, losing three crowns to 299.
Tobacco company Tabak, which is majority owned by Philip Morris, rose 18 crowns to 8,151.
